shorts.title: Chimpanzees Gang Up to Kill the Smallest Gorilla
shorts.hook: In twenty nineteen, chimpanzees were first recorded killing gorillas.
shorts.outro: Doug's other six deaths are in the full video below.
shorts.description: In the first lethal chimp attacks on gorillas ever recorded, numbers beat size and the smallest gorilla died both times, and the full episode shows why Doug should not have worn the gorilla suit.

shorts.title: Chimps Killed Their Neighbors, Then Had a Baby Boom
shorts.outro: Doug moves into the taken land in the full video below.
shorts.description: After Ngogo's chimpanzees killed their neighbours and took their land, births more than doubled and infant deaths collapsed, and the full episode follows Doug onto that taken land.

shorts.title: The Biggest Chimp Group Ever Known Split and Went to War
shorts.outro: Doug stands on the line between them in the full video below.
shorts.description: Ngogo, the largest chimpanzee community ever studied, split in two in 2018 and one side has been killing the other ever since, and the full episode puts Doug right on the line between them.
